description: SwiftUI + SwiftData app. Dead code that is still referenced, but only from other dead code: a branch on a computed property that always returns nil, and the card it would show; a full-screen cover whose flag is never set true, the view it opens, and the row only that view uses. Live look-alikes: a sheet driven by onOpenURL, a sheet driven by a row tap, a sheet whose flag a child sets through a Binding, the @main entry, a test discovered by name, and #Preview blocks that reference their own view.
prompt: Audit this repository for dead code and report your findings.

must_find.why: `resumable` is a computed property that always returns nil, so the `if let` branch can never run.
Its only reference outside its own #Preview is inside the unreachable branch in TodayView.
`showingArchive` is declared false and only ever bound, never set true, so the full-screen cover can never be presented.
Only opened by the cover that can never be presented (its #Preview is a self-reference).
Used only by ArchiveView, which is itself dead: two links down the chain.

must_not_flag.why: Presented by RootView's sheet, whose item is set in .onOpenURL.
The onOpenURL-driven sheet and the URL Identifiable conformance it needs.
Presented when a row tap sets `selected`.
Live sheet driven by the row tap.
The flag is set true by the child AboutButton through a Binding.
XCTest discovers it by naming convention.
